source.text: All entries › Dependency Copy as Markdown Copied ← → Dependency You might say I just downloaded the project and it reports a missing module. Is the code broken? Code packages written by others that a project needs; they must be installed before the project runs·Cloning a repo downloads only the package.json manifest, not the packages themselves; running directly throws 'Cannot find module'. Running an install command fetches third-party code packages into your local folder before the project can boot; swapping machines or pulling new code requires repeating this step. Know first npm Dependency From clone to start: when dependencies enter the project Just cloned Install dependencies Start the project my-first-page/ No node_modules yet package.json Records which packages are needed src/ node_modules/ Does not exist Terminal $ npm start Error: Cannot find module 'react' Dependencies are not installed yet The list is there but not the packages: install before starting For a missing module,
